id: title:danielcarletti:keep google sheets text unquoted in mixed columns

review.posthog_relevance: Google Sheets warehouse ingestion preserves mixed-type columns as strings rather than converting them to numbers, preventing data loss or JSON encoding artifacts for columns containing both numeric and text values.
